title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Morong, Province of Rizal and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular District Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Morong, Province of Rizal and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy Land Transportation Office tại Đô thị Morong, Tỉnh Rizal, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานเขตปกติ Land Transportation Office ในเทศบาล Morong จังหวัด Rizal และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Distrik Reguler Land Transportation Office di Kotamadya Morong, Provinsi Rizal, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Daerah Biasa Land Transportation Office di Perbandaran Morong, Wilayah Rizal, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established a regular district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the Municipality of Morong, Province of Rizal.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Municipality of Morong, Province of Rizal, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
